findings.summary: U2 pin DRDY (__unnamed_14) missing pull-up resistor
findings.description: Pin DRDY on U2 (NAU7802SGI) is connected to net __unnamed_14 but has no pull-up resistor. This pin type typically requires an external pull-up to a power rail for correct operation.
findings.recommendation: Add a 4.7k-10k pull-up resistor from __unnamed_14 to the appropriate power rail.

fix_params.basis: Pin DRDY is open-drain/input type requiring pull-up

report_context.impact: Pin may float or bus may not function without pull-up

findings.summary: Net I2C_SCL: 5.0V / 3.3V domain crossing without level shifter
findings.description: Net I2C_SCL connects ICs in 5.0V and 3.3V domains. The 5.0V output may exceed the 3.3V input absolute maximum rating of 3.6V, risking damage.
findings.recommendation: Add a level shifter between the 5.0V and 3.3V domains on net I2C_SCL, or verify that the connected ICs have tolerant inputs.

report_context.impact: Risk of damage or unreliable logic levels
